children: Xiaomi Corporation Class B (HKEX:1810) is accelerating beyond phones with a flurry of buybacks, a joint Hubei fund backing 100+ deals, a four‑model YU7 EV lineup (RMB209,900–299,900) and new devices including the Xiaomi 18 Fold, Pad 9 Pro Max and budget FX Pro TV, plus in‑house Xuanjie O3 chips.
Xiaomi Corp Class B Buybacks Sept
: Xiaomi Corp Class B (1810) reported four Sept buybacks: 362k shares HKD10M (Sept 7), 3M HKD82M (Sept 8), 1.9M HKD50M (Sept 9), 1.9M HKD49.3M (Sept 10).
Xiaomi Corp Class B YU7 EV Lineup
: Xiaomi Corp Class B (1810) launched YU7 EV lineup: four models (N70 Pro/Max, N90 Max, N90 Max Explorer). Prices RMB 209,900–299,900. Battery options 52/76 kWh. CLTC ranges up to 351–1,705 km.
Xiaomi Class B Joint Fund Hubei
: Xiaomi Class B (1810) set up a joint fund with Hubei province that completed 100+ investments, supporting Xiaomi’s expansion into EVs and other tech beyond smartphones.
Xiaomi Corp Class B 18 Fold Pad 9 Pro Max
: Xiaomi Corp Class B (1810) launched Xiaomi 18 Fold and Pad 9 Pro Max with in-house Xuanjie O3 chip. 18 Fold: 7.58" inner, 5.38" outer, 200MP main, 3.5x periscope, 6,000mAh battery.
: Xiaomi Corporation Class B (1810): traders note product push — Xiaomi FX Pro 55" QLED priced under Rs50,000, 4K, HDR10+, 60Hz native/120Hz input, Fire TV, 3 HDMI, 32GB storage.
